title: Fadullon flags possible lack of due diligence in cyberlibel case vs. Lustre
summary: Prosecutor General Richard Anthony Fadullon said he believes the prosecutor handling the cyberlibel case against journalist Philip Lustre may have failed to exercise due diligence.
